hypothesis: Explicit installed-electric versus actuator-ready ball-valve wording can produce one bounded state-specific retrieval alternate that improves recall without changing selection behavior.
why_now: Both control states appear in hard-gate core queries, catalog records explicitly encode them, and cycles 14–15 were infrastructure-inconclusive rather than scientific rejections.
expected_effect: Source retrieval remains intact while a catalog-native control-state alternate can surface better candidates; reranking and output keep the source query.
expected_metric_gain: +3.3–6.7 pp hard-pass coverage plausible; blind gain uncertain.
lesson_from_history: Narrow additive canonicalization was the only accepted family. Gating, selection, prompt, index-enrichment, and diversification changes were neutral or harmful; this is an untested retry after Qdrant outages.
candidate_hypotheses: State-specific installed-electric versus actuator-ready additive retrieval expansion (selected).
plan_summary: Created and strict-validated proposal, spec, design, and implementation-only tasks under openspec/changes/cycle-17-actuation-intent-retrieval-expansion/.
